text:
eric: Quick assist please 3 NovaTech evaluation is blocked. They call embeddings with our demo key and get 401 Invalid API key. They used sk-nova-demo-77 and send X-Redwood-Project: novatech-poc.

nina: Ask them for the exact curl and the DNS they resolve to. 401 usually means key not found/disabled or region mismatch. 403 would be project binding.

eric: They sent this (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-nova-demo-77" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Project: novatech-poc" \
  -d '{"input":"check"}'
```
Response: {"error":"Invalid API key","code":401}

infra-bot: log: [2026-09-14T08:22:10Z] key=sk-nova-demo-77 action=auth-check result=not-found region=us-west-2

mohammed: infra-bot shows key exists in eu-west-1 but request hit us-west-2. Their corporate edge pins outbound to us-west-2 for compliance. Two options: create a temp presales key in us-west-2 or ask infra to route to eu-west-1.

nina: Also verify they didn't accidentally rotate to a short-lived token. We have an internal debug endpoint they can call (mask secrets) to show key metadata: `GET https://internal.redwood/debug/key-binding` which prints bound_org/bound_projects/region/scopes.

eric: I generated a short-lived presales key bound to novatech-poc in us-west-2 and sent via secure DM. Command (admin only): `redwoodctl keys create --org novatech --project novatech-poc --region us-west-2 --scopes embeddings --ttl 8h --label "novatech presales temp"`

infra-bot: log: [2026-09-14T08:24:02Z] key=sk-nova-temp-9 created owner=eric region=us-west-2 bound_projects=["novatech-poc"] ttl=8h

eric: Customer retried and now gets 200 + embeddings. 

mohammed: Follow-ups: 1) revoke the old sk-nova-demo-77 and rotate 2) update NovaTech sample repo to prefer api.redwood.ai or include `--region` flag examples 3) nina to capture their expected daily volume (they mentioned ~80k/day) for pricing note 4) share programmatic revoke snippet for security questionnaire.

nina: Revoke snippet for presales/security doc: `curl -X DELETE https://control.redwood.ai/v1/keys/{key_id} -H "Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>"` (we will not share admin tokens). Production customers can rotate via UI/API with service creds; Private deployments can be KMS-integrated. I'll draft the paragraph for the questionnaire.

eric: Done. Customer back in testing and happy to proceed with evaluation week. Closing thread.
